description: This file implements a Decryption class providing methods for symmetric and asymmetric decryption, input transformation, and stream creation within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Decryption
classes.description: A class providing static methods for decrypting data using various cryptographic techniques, including stream decryption.

methods.name: transformInput
methods.description: Converts cipher data from string or Uint8Array to Uint8Array based on format.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs symmetric decryption of cipher data with optional output formatting.

methods.name: decryptAsymmetric
methods.description: Performs asymmetric decryption using a key pair with optional output formatting.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream for decrypting data chunks using secret stream.
